horses.incident_text: Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted in shortly after the start and was bumped. H Bowman was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides near the 300 Metres. Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped at the start and became unbalanced.  When caught wide in the early stages was then shifted across behind runners to obtain a position with cover near the 900 Metres.
Shortly after the start was bumped by NOBLE DELUXE which shifted in.
Jumped only fairly and then from a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
R Kingscote was warned in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on one occasion near the 250 Metres.

Shifted out at the start, made contact with ORIENTAL SURPRISE and became unbalanced.  From a wide barrier was then shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 100 Metres was steadied when disappointed for clear running between HAPPY TANGO and SOMETHING JONAH which shifted out.  As a result SUPER ELITE was not able to be ridden out to the finish of the event.

Jumped only fairly and from a wide barrier was then shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  After the event Z Purton stated that his mount did not respond to his riding in the Home Straight after settling back in the field.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a laceration to the right hock.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Over the final 200 Metres was taken wider by INCREDIBLE MOMENT (L Ferraris) which shifted out whilst being ridden along.  L Ferraris was advised he must stop riding and straighten his mounts when they shift ground whilst not clear to do so.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Shifted out under riding over the final 200 Metres.  L Ferraris was warned for using his whip in a forehand manner forward of the saddle on one occasion over the concluding stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Shifted out shortly after the start and was bumped.
Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded by CALL TO COMMAND which shifted out despite the efforts of its rider.
No report.

Jumped only fairly and then shortly after the start became unbalanced when bumped by CIRCUIT VICTORY which shifted out.  In the middle stages raced keenly and for some distance approaching the 900 Metres was steadied to avoid CIRCUIT VICTORY.

Shortly after the start was hampered when crowded between CHEVAL VICTORIOUS and INCREDIBLE MOMENT which shifted in slightly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Shortly after the start got its head up when it shifted out and away from HAPPY ALLIANCE.  In the early stages raced ungenerously and got its head up.  Approaching the 250 Metres was eased to avoid HAPPY ALLIANCE when that runner shifted out slightly.  Noted to have sustained a laceration to the left hind leg after the race.
No report.
On jumping became unbalanced when it made contact with SNOWTHORN.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

After being placed in the starting gates reared, struck its head and was noted to have blood in its mouth.  Acting on veterinary advice that SAVVY TWINKLE was not suitable to race the horse was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.  Before being allowed to race again, SAVVY TWINKLE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Lay out making the Home Turn and in the Home Straight.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped on jumping and became unbalanced.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Bumped shortly after the start.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Slow to begin.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Slow to begin. Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Shifted out on jumping and made contact with HAPPY ACTION.  Near the 700 Metres made contact with the running rail.
Jumped only fairly.
No report.

After the event M F Poon reported that his mount resented the kickback from the leader SPICY SPANGLE and, in his opinion, this was the reason for the horse failing to run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped only fairly and was bumped shortly after the start.

After the event Apprentice E C W Wong stated that his mount travelled satisfactorily outside the lead in the early stages but gave ground noticeably over the concluding stages and he could offer no explanation for its disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of ROBOT KNIGHT was considered disappointing.  Before being allowed to race again, ROBOT KNIGHT will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Y L Chung was issued with a reprimand for using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on one occasion near the 150 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Shortly after the start was crowded by BIG STRIDE which shifted in despite the efforts of its rider.  In the early stages raced keenly and near the 1100 Metres got its head up when positioned close to TOY SOLTERO.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped at the start.  Had difficulty obtaining clear running between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres.

Slow to begin. Raced keenly in the middle stages.  For a short distance near the 150 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when improving into a narrow run between WINNING MACHINE and GOOD LUCK BABE.
Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.

After the event M F Poon stated that the intention was to hold a midfield position.  He said when DREAMING WINNER commenced well it was able to obtain a more forward position without being pressured to do so.
Jumped awkwardly, made contact with SIGHT DREAMER and then from a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
No report.
Bumped on jumping.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Shifted in shortly after the start and was corrected by its rider.

After the event Apprentice E C W Wong advised the intention was to hold a forward position.  He said THE HEIR jumped awkwardly and as a result lost ground when then obliged him to settle at the rear of the field.  He added that in the Home Straight THE HEIR was unable to make up any appreciable ground from this position.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly and then made contact with EXCEL WONGCHOY.  After the event H Bentley reported that when caught wide in the early stages he was obliged to make use of his mount to cross runners to his inside and lead to avoid being caught wide and without cover.  He added as a consequence WINNING MACHINE did not finish the race off strongly in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly.  Leaving the 200 Metres endeavoured to obtain a narrow run to the inside of WINNING MACHINE which was commencing to give ground.  When WINNING MACHINE shifted in near the 150 Metres SUPERB GUY was then checked when disappointed for this run and as a consequence could not be tested to the finish of the event.
Jumped awkwardly.  After the event D Probert reported that his mount over-raced in the middle stages.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: Withdrawn on 11.10.25 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter BLING BLING GENIUS.  Before being allowed to race again, WINNING DATA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

blackbook_suggestions.reason: Must pass vet exam before racing again

horses.incident_text: Jumped awkwardly, shifted out and made contact with GIDDY UP.  Near the 900 Metres was crowded between GOOD FORTUNE which shifted out when positioned close to GIDDY UP and VOYAGE BOSS which lay in towards LUCKY MCQUEEN and was steadied to avoid that runner.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly, shifted out and made contact with the hindquarters of GOOD FORTUNE.  Briefly held up for clear running near the 400 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly.  Noted to have sustained a laceration to the left hock.
When questioned K C Leung stated that near the 900 Metres his mount lay in and away from BUNTA BABY and was steadied to avoid LUCKY MCQUEEN.

Had its left front plate refitted in the saddling stalls, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Near the 1100 Metres was steadied when crowded by VOYAGE BOSS which shifted in and away from BUNTA BABY (Apprentice P N Wong) after being taken in by that runner.  Apprentice Wong was advised to exercise more care.

Bumped on the hindquarters on jumping.  Despite being ridden along in the early stages was unable to show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.  Noted to have sustained a laceration to the right front leg.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 900 Metres was steadied to avoid CLUB ACE and as a result shifted out.  After the event Apprentice E C W Wong stated that when caught wide in the early stages he was obliged to restrain his mount and race at the rear of the field to avoid covering additional ground.
Bumped at the start.  Approaching the 500 Metres was eased when crowded between LUCKY MCQUEEN and JUBILANT STAR which shifted out slightly.

Jumped only fairly and then raced in restricted room between INVICTUS DRAGON and LUCKY MCQUEEN which shifted out slightly.  After the event L Ferraris reported that the intention was to hold a more forward position but his mount settled further back when it jumped only fairly and was tightened shortly after the start.
Near the 900 Metres was bumped by OLDTOWN and became unbalanced.

Leaving the 900 Metres was steadied to avoid BUNTA BABY (Apprentice P N Wong) which shifted in when not clear.  Apprentice Wong was severely reprimanded and advised she must ensure she is sufficiently clear when shifting ground.

After the event A Badel stated that from an inside barrier his mount commenced well and was able to take up a forward position in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have bled from both nostrils.  Before being allowed to race again, ELEGANT LIFE will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Trainer M Newnham confirmed that he had instructed L Hewitson to ride the horse with cover today.  Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  Briefly held up near the 300 Metres.  Near the 100 Metres improved into a narrow run to the inside of HAPPY UNIVERSE as that runner shifted in slightly.  As a result BULL ATTITUDE was momentarily crowded by HAPPY UNIVERSE, resulting in those two runners making contact.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Near the 100 Metres shifted in and made contact with BULL ATTITUDE.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out to the finish when racing in restricted room between BEAUTY MISSILE and PEARL OF PANG’S which shifted out slightly.
No report.
Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between ROMANTIC FANTASY and GLORIOUS SUCCESS.
Shortly after the start was bumped by PEARL OF PANG’S which shifted out slightly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

After the event H T Mo reported that the instructions were to hold a midfield position.  He said when his mount commenced well he was able to race in the lead without being pressured to do so.  He added that once he obtained the lead his mount raced keenly and did not settle throughout the early and middle stages.
Shortly after the start was eased when crowded by BEAUTY MISSILE which shifted in slightly.  Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when positioned close to the heels of FIGHT TIME.
Jumped only fairly and then was bumped by BULL ATTITUDE which shifted in.
No report.

Approaching the 300 Metres was steadied when crowded between PRESTIGE RICKY (C L Chau) and BEAUTY MISSILE (A Badel), both of which shifted ground.  Both C L Chau and A Badel were advised to exercise more care.  Raced very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

When questioned Apprentice E C W Wong stated that his instructions from a wide barrier were to be positive on the horse.  He said when MATTERS MOST commenced well he was able to take advantage of the good start to cross runners to his inside and lead.  Trainer C S Shum confirmed the instructions issued.  Sent for sampling post-race.

After being crossed by MATTERS MOST approaching the 900 Metres raced keenly for some distance thereafter.  Between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres raced in restricted room between MATTERS MOST and ALSONSO when improving into a narrow run between those two horses.  Sent for sampling post-race.

After the event A Badel stated that he was instructed to obtain a forward position.  When questioned regarding his riding making the Home Turn and in the early stages of the Home Straight A Badel stated that approaching the 500 Metres he received a call from Z Purton, rider of SUPER STRONG KID, when ALSONSO shifted in slightly.  He said as a consequence he looked to his inside and corrected his mount to avoid crowding the running of SUPER STRONG KID.  He added that when he placed ALSONSO under pressure entering the Home Straight it changed stride and lay out which resulted in a run presenting for SUPER STRONG KID to his inside.
No report.
Jumped only fairly.  In the Home Straight lay in under pressure.  Near the 50 Metres raced tight to the inside of POWER KOEPP which shifted in.
Bumped at the start.  In the middle stages raced keenly and approaching the 800 Metres shifted out when being steadied away from GOLDEN EMPIRE.
No report.

After the event A Atzeni stated that his mount was slow to begin but was able to show sufficient pace in the early stages to hold an on-pace position behind the favourite SUPER STRONG KID.  He added after initially responding to his riding in the early stages of the Home Straight YEE CHEONG GLORY was unable to finish the race off over the final 150 Metres where it gave ground over the concluding stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.
On jumping bumped with POWER KOEPP.  Approaching the 400 Metres made contact with TACTICAL COMMAND when being shifted out to improve.
Approaching the 400 Metres was bumped by NOVA KNIGHT.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Near the 300 Metres was bumped by FATAL BLOW which shifted out.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Near the 700 Metres made contact with GUMMY GUMMY due to both runners shifting ground.
Bumped near the 300 Metres.
No report.
Near the 700 Metres made contact with GIANT LEAP due to both runners shifting ground.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: Near the 750 Metres became unbalanced when crowded by NEW FOREST (L Hewitson) which shifted in before being corrected by its rider.  L Hewitson was reprimanded and advised that he should have made an effort sooner to relieve the tightening to SOLID SHALAA.  In assessing the incident the Stewards also took into consideration that NEW FOREST shifted in and away from BLAZING WIND.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, SOLID SHALAA will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Jumped only fairly.

After the event H Bowman stated that after settling towards the back of the field he was unable to proceed forward between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres when held up behind SOLID SHALAA which shifted out.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Noted to have blood in the mouth on arrival at the Start, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Jumped only fairly.

blackbook_suggestions.reason: Must pass vet exam before racing again

horses.incident_text: Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.
Shifted out on jumping, resulting in its rider having to straighten his mount.  In the Home Straight had some difficulty obtaining clear running when positioned to the inside of BABY CRYSTAL.
No report.
Jumped awkwardly.  Between the 400 Metres and the 250 Metres lay in as it improved into a narrow run between BRAVE STAR and WONDER KIT.

Jumped only fairly and then was crowded between MID WINTER WIND and GORGEOUS WIN which was taken out by LADY’S CHOICE.  After the event Apprentice E C W Wong stated that after being crowded at the start DANCING CODE settled further back than anticipated and found it difficult to make up ground from back in the field.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
On jumping was crowded by WONDER KIT which shifted out despite the efforts of its rider.

Jumped only fairly.  In the early stages raced ungenerously when being shifted across behind runners to obtain cover.  Near the 250 Metres was steadied when crowded between DANCING CODE and GORGEOUS WIN (H Bowman) which shifted out.  H Bowman was advised to exercise more care.

Crowded at the start.  After the event H Bowman stated that his mount responded only fairly to his riding in the Home Straight and shortened stride during the middle stages of the race.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Shifted in on jumping and was bumped on the hindquarters.  After the event L Hewitson stated that his mount came under pressure at the 500 Metres and did not finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.

A Badel was fined the sum of $5,000 for breaching Rule 100(3)(ii)(f) in that he used his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on two occasions over the concluding stages.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Leaving the 800 Metres was steadied to avoid COLOURFUL KNIGHT.  A short distance later TIN FOOK shifted out and made contact with THE RED HARE.  Held up making the Home Turn and in the early stages of the Home Straight.  M F Poon pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference over the concluding stages (see SUGAR BALL).
Made contact with the left side of its starting gate on jumping and lost ground.  SOLID WIN was then crowded between COLOURFUL KNIGHT and THE RED HARE.

Jumped awkwardly and then shortly after was crowded by SUGAR BALL which shifted out on jumping.  Bumped near the 700 Metres.  Prior to declaring weighed-in the Stewards gave consideration if there were grounds for a protest/objections on behalf of the 5th placegetter THE RED HARE which was taken wider by TIN FOOK over the concluding stages.  When the Stewards were satisfied there were not sufficient grounds to lodge a protest/objection and the connections chose not to, weighed-in was declared on the numbers semaphored by the Judge.
No report.

Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  M F Poon (TIN FOOK) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that over the concluding stages he directed his mount to the outside of MASTER OF ALL where there was not sufficient room to do so, resulting in TIN FOOK making contact with THE RED HARE and taking that horse across the running of SUGAR BALL which was checked.  M F Poon was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Sunday, 2 November 2025 and to expire on Thursday, 6 November 2025 on which day he may resume race riding (2 Hong Kong racedays).  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his good race riding record.  After the event K C Leung reported that he was unable to ride SUGAR BALL out to the finish of the race due to his mount receiving interference over the concluding stages.

In the middle stages raced keenly.  Approaching the 900 Metres was steadied to avoid IGOR STRAVINSKY.  Over the concluding stages was steadied to avoid THE RED HARE when that runner was taken out by TIN FOOK.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
D Probert was warned in relation to using his whip in a manner where the hand holding the whip was above shoulder height on one occasion near the 150 Metres.
Shortly after the start raced in restricted room between IGOR STRAVINSKY and JUNEAU PRIDE.
After the event M Chadwick could offer no explanation for his mount’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

The performance of COLOURFUL KNIGHT, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, COLOURFUL KNIGHT will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.   A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
